messages:
elaine_cs: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp onboarding — error-rate breakdown for week ending 2026-03-20. Main asks: 1) top failing endpoints (5xx, timeouts, rate limits), 2) short root-cause notes, 3) visible customer impact + renewal/risk flags, 4) remediation owners.

marc_engineering: Pulled the traces. Major signal: 5xx spike on the model-gateway service after last Friday's small rollout. Top offending endpoint: `POST /v1/generate` (model-gateway-v3). 7d avg 5xx ~3.2% -> this week 12.1%.

sam_sre: Seeing corresponding TCP timeouts to backend model pool and a lot of Redis timeouts for session locks. Could be connection pool exhaustion on gateway nodes. Logs: `ERROR model-gateway timeout after 10s to 10.1.2.45` repeating. :warning:

lina_support: Acme customer reported increased failures in onboarding smoke tests yesterday afternoon and paused automated onboarding. They're asking for ETA — they mentioned potential renewal discussion next month. High-touch flagging recommended.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] 2026-03-19T18:42:11Z model-gateway error_rate POST /v1/generate > 10% for 15m. Incident created: INC-2026-134.

marc_engineering: Quick summary table from our query (top by error impact):
```
endpoint                         | error_type  | 7d_avg | this_week | pct_change
POST /v1/generate                | 5xx         | 3.2%   | 12.1%    | +8.9pp
POST /v1/chat/respond            | timeout     | 0.4%   | 2.8%     | +2.4pp
GET /v1/embed                    | rate_limit  | 0.1%   | 1.3%     | +1.2pp
POST /v1/session/lock            | timeout     | 0.0%   | 0.9%     | +0.9pp
```
Note: the generate endpoint accounts for ~68% of the token usage for Acme, so its 5xx surge drives the account-level error-rate.

sam_sre: Root causes we're seeing: 1) connection pool config change in last deploy reduced max concurrent backend connections (accidentally lowered). 2) Redis cluster experiencing intermittent higher latency causing session lock waits. 3) Some clients retried aggressively causing rate-limit churn to embedding endpoint.

elaine_cs: Flags on renewal risk: high. Lina — recommend scheduling an ASAP customer update and offer a workaround (pin to older model variant / pause heavy batch jobs).

lina_support: I'll message Acme with an interim mitigation: switch to `model-legacy-1` via route override or temporarily reduce parallel requests. I'll propose a follow-up call tomorrow 09:30 PT.

marc_engineering: Immediate actions I've started: rolling back the pool config change to previous values on canary nodes, increasing `max_sockets` for gateway-to-backend connections. Monitoring will show by next 10–15 min. Also adding an alert rule to catch pool saturation earlier.

sam_sre: Added a short-term tolerance in Redis client timeouts and bumped connection counts for Redis proxies. Will instrument additional metrics for session lock latency.

elaine_cs: Customer comms + internal remediation owners:
- marc_engineering: rollback + pool tuning (ETA 30m)
- sam_sre: Redis tweaks + locks instrumentation (ETA 2h)
- lina_support: Customer update + set renewal watch (ETA 1h)
- elaine_cs: coordinate follow-up + confirm canary health (ETA 3h)

marc_engineering: Confirmed rollback started. Canary nodes show 5xx falling: `POST /v1/generate` down to ~4.5% after config revert.

deploy-bot: [RESOLVE] 2026-03-19T19:03:22Z INC-2026-134 status -> mitigated (partial). Auto-triage: continue monitoring for 24h.

lina_support: Customer call scheduled 2026-03-20 09:30 PT. I shared a short mitigation guide and asked them to re-run onboarding tests after 30m.

elaine_cs: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Marc to validate with load test that pool change safe, Sam to produce a short postmortem entry with root cause and lessons, Lina to capture customer sentiment and update renewal tracker. We'll re-check this thread during next weekly on Mon. :thumbsup:
